releaseNotes:
- Adds an optional Java 8 SDK `SendMessageRequest.modelRef` property with fluent and JavaBean accessors, allowing a real message to select an authorized `providerId/modelId`
- Keeps existing Java callers compatible: omitted or null model references are absent from JSON and continue using the conversation's saved model; response models never become implicit request overrides
- Verifies omitted and explicit selection, new and existing conversations, remembered model changes, rejected selections and protection of unfinished turns through the external SDK contract
- Publishes the Java SDK binary, dependency POM and source JAR together with release checksums and documents GitHub download and local Maven installation
- Reuses Runtime `1.0.0` and existing sandbox templates; preserves configuration, conversations, workspace files, attachments and Skills

### Java 8 SDK

- [agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3-sources.jar](https://github.com/wutianle/agentos-releases/releases/download/v2.0.3/agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3-sources.jar)
- [agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.jar](https://github.com/wutianle/agentos-releases/releases/download/v2.0.3/agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.jar)
- [agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.pom](https://github.com/wutianle/agentos-releases/releases/download/v2.0.3/agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.pom)

Install the downloaded binary with its dependency POM and sources:

```sh
mvn install:install-file -Dfile=agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.jar -DpomFile=agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3.pom -Dsources=agentos-java8-sdk-2.0.3-sources.jar
```

Maven coordinates: `com.agentos:agentos-java8-sdk:2.0.3`. Omit `modelRef` to keep the saved conversation model; set it explicitly to an authorized `providerId/modelId` for a new turn. Existing external Java applications must update their SDK dependency separately.
